Name: LOAD_BALANCER_NEW_DRAW_DIST_SCALE_PARAM_ST
Description: Draw-distance and shadow-distance scales by load level, chosen by PartsDrawParam's Load Balancer Scale ID (rows 0–47; a higher ID or missing row means 1). Below Level Start the scale is Scale Start; from Level Start to Level End it moves linearly to Scale End; from Level End up it is Scale End. A change in scale is eased in over 0.5 s. The load level (0–20) is the game's own draw-distance load level, raised automatically when the frame rate stays low; it is not the LoadBalancerParam level. On PC only LoadBalancerNewDrawDistScaleParam_win64 is read; the console variants (_ps4, _ps5, _xb1, _xb1x, _xss, _xsx) are not used.

Fields.Name: Draw Distance - Level Start
Fields.Description: Load level (0–20) where the draw-distance scale starts moving from Scale Start toward Scale End. 21 = never (scale stays at Scale Start). Retail: 1 in scaled rows, 21 otherwise.

Fields.Name: Draw Distance - Level End
Fields.Description: Load level where the draw-distance scale reaches Scale End and stays there. If equal to Level Start, the scale jumps to Scale End at that level. Retail: 20.

Fields.Name: Draw Distance - Scale Start
Fields.Description: Multiplier on PartsDrawParam's draw distance at load levels below Level Start. Retail: 1.

Fields.Name: Draw Distance - Scale End
Fields.Description: Multiplier on PartsDrawParam's draw distance at Level End and above. Retail: 0.25–1.

Fields.Name: Shadow Draw Distance - Level Start
Fields.Description: Load level (0–20) where the shadow draw-distance scale starts moving from Scale Start toward Scale End. 21 = never. Retail: 1 in scaled rows, 21 otherwise.

Fields.Name: Shadow Draw Distance - Level End
Fields.Description: Load level where the shadow draw-distance scale reaches Scale End and stays there. If equal to Level Start, the scale jumps to Scale End at that level. Retail: 20.

Fields.Name: Shadow Draw Distance - Scale Start
Fields.Description: Multiplier on PartsDrawParam's shadow draw distance at load levels below Level Start. Retail: 1.

Fields.Name: Shadow Draw Distance - Scale End
Fields.Description: Multiplier on PartsDrawParam's shadow draw distance at Level End and above. Retail: 0.25–1.
